question: Within a radius of 110 kilometers, where can I locate café on the journey from Cardiovascular Institute of New England, Cranston, RI to Piano Craft Gallery, Boston, MA?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-71.472092 41.786868)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-71.081964 42.338711)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE amenity = 'cafe'
AND ST_DWithin(pois.geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-71.472092 41.786868)',4326)::geography, 110000)
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-71.472092 41.786868)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5);
